scenario: A real estate transaction coordinator reviews a residential purchase agreement and county title search report using legaldoc-ai to extract lien and encumbrance items, then feeds the structured output into afrexai-real-estate-engine for a full due diligence pass, and finally uses reporting to produce a pre-closing transaction summary that the escrow officer uses to verify the property is clear for closing.
info_flow: legaldoc-ai parses the title search PDF and purchase agreement, extracts all lien and encumbrance clauses with structured status fields -> afrexai-real-estate-engine ingests those status fields as part of its due diligence checklist, normalizes them into a clearance summary table -> reporting compiles the clearance summary into a pre-closing transaction worksheet, which the escrow officer uses to confirm the property title is clean.
